tables.name: waitlist_entries
tables.purpose: Each row represents one shopper's expressed interest in being notified when a specific variant (or product) comes back in stock.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: internal id

columns.name: shopper_email
columns.purpose: email address to notify

columns.name: product_external_id
columns.purpose: the product this entry is associated with

columns.name: variant_external_id
columns.purpose: the specific variant; null when signup is at product level

columns.name: item_display_name
columns.purpose: human-readable label captured at signup time for use in notification emails

columns.name: item_page_url
columns.purpose: URL to the product page, included in the notification email

columns.name: signup_level
columns.purpose: whether the signup is at variant or product level

columns.name: status
columns.purpose: active, notified, converted, or unsubscribed

columns.name: unsubscribe_token
columns.purpose: unique token embedded in notification emails for one-click unsubscribe

columns.name: notified_at
columns.purpose: timestamp of most recent notification send

columns.name: notification_batch_id
columns.purpose: the batch that last notified this entry

tables.name: notification_batches
tables.purpose: Tracks each restock notification run for a specific item including dispatch status, scheduled send time, and subscriber count for quiet-hours scheduling and idempotency.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: internal id

columns.name: product_external_id
columns.purpose: the product that restocked

columns.name: variant_external_id
columns.purpose: the variant that restocked; null for product-level batches

columns.name: variant_gid
columns.purpose: canonical Shopify GID for the variant (gid://shopify/ProductVariant/<id>), stored from the inventoryItem API response for use in subsequent Shopify ops

columns.name: available_quantity_at_detection
columns.purpose: stock level observed at restock detection, used to cap notification count

columns.name: status
columns.purpose: pending, sending, or completed

columns.name: entries_notified
columns.purpose: number of waitlist entries included in this batch

columns.name: detected_at
columns.purpose: when the restock event was received

columns.name: scheduled_send_at
columns.purpose: earliest time this batch may be dispatched, accounting for quiet hours

tables.name: conversions
tables.purpose: Records when a previously-notified shopper purchases the item they were waiting for within the 7-day attribution window, enabling demand-recovery metrics.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: internal id

columns.name: waitlist_entry_id
columns.constraints: NOT NULL REFERENCES waitlist_entries(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.purpose: the waitlist entry that led to this purchase

columns.name: order_external_id
columns.purpose: the paid order that triggered conversion detection

columns.name: shopper_email
columns.purpose: denormalised for query efficiency

columns.name: product_external_id
columns.purpose: the product purchased

columns.name: variant_external_id
columns.purpose: the variant purchased

columns.name: notified_at
columns.purpose: when the notification was sent, for attribution window calculation

columns.name: converted_at
columns.purpose: when the order was paid

tables.name: notification_settings
tables.purpose: Single-row table holding the merchant's notification message template and quiet-hours configuration.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: internal id

columns.name: notification_subject_template
columns.constraints: NOT NULL DEFAULT '{{product_name}} is back in stock!'
columns.purpose: template string with product name and item detail placeholders for notification subject line

columns.name: notification_body_template
columns.constraints:
NOT NULL DEFAULT '

Great news! {{item_detail}} is back in stock.

Shop now

Unsubscribe

'
columns.purpose: HTML content template with product name, item detail, item URL, and unsubscribe link placeholders

columns.name: quiet_hours_start
columns.purpose: local time (HH:MM) after which sends are held

columns.name: quiet_hours_end
columns.purpose: local time (HH:MM) when sends resume

columns.name: timezone
columns.purpose: IANA timezone name for interpreting quiet hours

tables.name: dashboard_snapshots
tables.purpose: Pre-aggregated per-item waitlist and conversion counts refreshed after each batch completes, enabling instant admin dashboard load without full-table scans.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: internal id

columns.name: product_external_id
columns.purpose: the product this snapshot covers

columns.name: variant_external_id
columns.purpose: the variant; null for product-level aggregates

columns.name: item_display_name
columns.purpose: product and variant label for rendering without a Shopify lookup

columns.name: active_waitlist_count
columns.purpose: number of entries currently awaiting notification

columns.name: total_signups
columns.purpose: all-time signup count

columns.name: total_notified
columns.purpose: all-time notified count

columns.name: total_conversions
columns.purpose: all-time conversion count

columns.name: last_restock_at
columns.purpose: most recent restock detection timestamp

widget.purpose: Check whether a specific variant or product is currently sold out so the widget knows whether to render the signup form.
Return whether a given email is already on the waitlist for a specific item.
Record a shopper's waitlist signup for a sold-out item; duplicate signups are silently ignored.
Process a one-click unsubscribe from all waitlists for the shopper identified by the token.

admin.purpose: Return products and variants ranked by active waitlist size with aggregate demand-recovery metrics.
Return the paginated list of individual subscribers waiting for a specific product or variant.
Stream all subscriber rows for a given item as a CSV download.
Fetch the current notification template and quiet-hours settings.
Save the merchant's edited notification subject and body template.
Save the merchant's quiet-hours start time, end time, and timezone.
